prompt: Create a local notes database, insert the fixture marker exactly once, reconcile a lost response using the original receipt, update the marker, read it through a fresh client, then remove the disposable database.

conditions.versions: Python 3.11+; record actual runtime in capture

reset_policy: fresh temporary workspace and evidence store for every lifecycle

environment.cpu: record actual CPU allocation at execution
environment.memory: record actual RAM allocation at execution

exclusions: evaluator or runtime faults invalidate calibration; product access is not exercised
stopping_rule: all three reference lifecycles or first calibration failure
